learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn to look at beautiful pictures and say what we see!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Look at the big picture in your book. What do you see? Point to the fun things you find.
Tell your family what is happening in the picture. Use short words and smile.
Take your beautiful crayons. Draw your favourite thing from the picture and color it bright.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 🕵️‍♀️ I Spy Game!
fun_activity.instructions: Look around your room right now. Point to three things and say their names out loud to your parents!

quick_recap: ⭐ We looked at fun and colourful pictures.
⭐ We learned new words for things around us.
⭐ We pointed at things and said their names.
